result.instructions: Afterimage read-only instructions v1: Pass the exact checkout as path on every call. Use search_symbols then exact symbol_id for context/callers/callees/impact. For JSX component usage use find_all_references; JSX_USES is a reference, not a call. Read Project, coverage, freshness and truncation warnings in text. Empty results do not prove absence. NOT_INDEXED requires an explicit indexing action outside this profile; do not switch to a parent/sibling. Compiler NOT_REQUESTED/FAILED is partial coverage even when requested AST work succeeded. Verify current source before editing.

tools.description: Read-only diagnostics plus full selected-source content freshness verification for the specified checkout; may read every supported source file. No repair or refresh. Graph coverage may be partial and freshness unknown; results are not exhaustive. Verify current source.
tools.name: diagnose

tools.description: Optionally search the existing local symbol graph using lexical BM25. Copy a returned symbol_id for other tools. Limit defaults to 10 (maximum 1000). No models, downloads, caches, or watchers. Graph coverage may be partial and freshness unknown; results are not exhaustive. Verify current source.

tools.name: get_symbols_in_file

tools.description: Graph statistics plus full selected-source content freshness verification for the specified checkout; may read every supported source file. Explicit refresh outside MCP selects immutable snapshots. Graph coverage may be partial and freshness unknown; results are not exhaustive. Verify current source.
tools.name: get_stats

tools.description: Optionally inspect indexed direct callers. Obtain the exact symbol_id from search_symbols or get_symbols_in_file. Set include_tests=false to exclude test callers. Sibling methods are excluded by default; expand_interface=true includes indexed callers of sibling methods. Graph coverage may be partial and freshness unknown; results are not exhaustive. Verify current source.

expand_interface.description: Aggregate callers across every sibling method on the same class/interface, not just symbol_id. Use when assessing the impact of changing the whole interface.

include_tests.description: Include test-function/method callers. Set false to see only non-test callers.

tools.name: trace_callers

tools.description: Optionally inspect indexed direct callees. Obtain the exact symbol_id from search_symbols or get_symbols_in_file. Set include_tests=false to exclude test callees. Graph coverage may be partial and freshness unknown; results are not exhaustive. Verify current source.

include_tests.description: Include test-function/method callees. Set false to see only non-test callees.

tools.name: trace_callees

tools.description: Optionally inspect reverse CALLS edges up to depth. Obtain the exact symbol_id from search_symbols or get_symbols_in_file. Sibling methods are excluded by default; expand_interface=true includes indexed impact through sibling methods. Graph coverage may be partial and freshness unknown; results are not exhaustive. Verify current source.

expand_interface.description: Aggregate impact across every sibling method on the same class/interface, not just symbol_id. Use when assessing the impact of changing the whole interface.

tools.name: transitive_impact

tools.description: Optionally retrieve a source snippet for a symbol. Obtain the exact symbol_id from search_symbols or get_symbols_in_file. Graph coverage may be partial and freshness unknown; results are not exhaustive. Verify current source.
tools.name: get_code_snippet

tools.description: Optionally inspect indexed context for a symbol, including callers and callees. Obtain the exact symbol_id from search_symbols or get_symbols_in_file. Graph coverage may be partial and freshness unknown; results are not exhaustive. Verify current source.
tools.name: symbol_context

tools.description: Optionally inspect indexed lexical CALLS and JSX_USES component value references. JSX_USES does not imply invocation. Locations identify enclosing symbol declarations.
